extraction: backend/src/syllabus-parse.js over the PDF text in content-stream order; COs and unit text verbatim (whitespace normalised); topics split at ";", sentence ends, "Heading:" and comma lists
selection_note: Exactly 14 theory subjects. The source has one theory course each in Semesters I and II, so those contribute one each; Semesters III and IV contribute three, V-VII two each. Semester VIII is excluded only to satisfy the 14-subject limit.

Compare various software development methodologies ad conclude on their applicability in developing specific type of product.
Construct an efficient design specification document for attainment of user desired product.
Develop applications using the concepts of various phases of software development life cycle.
Study various software testing techniques and identify their relevance to developing a quality software.
